title: Count the letter r in the word strawberry
rationale: Character counting exposes tokenization blind spots; a model that miscounts letters corrupts data extraction, validation and redaction tasks that users assume are trivial.

prompt.content: You are a precise counting assistant. Answer with the number only, with no other text.
Count every occurrence of the lowercase letter r in the word strawberry. Answer with the number only.

notes: Repeats=3 and all three must pass (score_probe_scoring semantics). Deterministic: static prompt, temperature 0, one integer answer. Expected value 3: the r letters sit at 1-based positions 3, 8 and 9 of strawberry. Brittleness: a spelled-out answer such as 'three' fails the numeric unit even though it is correct, and the system prompt requests the number only.
